# bluestonepim_compound_attribute_definition (Resource)

Compound attribute definition: an attribute combining the values of several other attribute definitions and hard-coded texts. The value is not editable on products.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_attribute_definition" "amount" {
  name      = "Amount"
  data_type = "decimal"
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_definition" "unit" {
  name      = "Unit"
  data_type = "text"
}

resource "bluestonepim_compound_attribute_definition" "quantity" {
  name   = "Quantity"
  number = "quantity"

  sub_definitions = [
    { id = bluestonepim_attribute_definition.amount.id },
    { id = bluestonepim_attribute_definition.unit.id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the attribute definition.
- `sub_definitions` (Attributes List) The attribute definitions the compound attribute consists of, in order. Multi select, dictionary, matrix and column definitions are not supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sub_definitions))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the attribute definition.
- `external_source` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is an external source.
- `format` (List of String) The display format of the compound attribute, combining the sub definition values with hard-coded texts.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the attribute group (see `bluestonepim_attribute_group`).
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is internal.
- `number` (String) The number of the attribute definition.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform-generated unique identifier of the attribute definition.

<a id="nestedatt--sub_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sub_definitions`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the attribute definition.

Optional:

- `compound` (Boolean) Whether the referenced definition is itself a compound attribute definition.
